mechanism_of_action: Engineered analog of the human hormone FGF19.
primary_endpoint: Change in Enhanced Liver Fibrosis from baseline to week 48.
efficacy_outcome: At week 48, the 3 mg group had a least-squares mean difference in ELF change of −0.5 versus placebo (95% CI −0.7 to −0.2; p=0.0003).
safety_signal: Diarrhea occurred in 26% and 40% of the 1 mg and 3 mg groups, respectively, versus 18% with placebo. Treatment-related adverse events led to discontinuation in 2% and 9% of the 1 mg and 3 mg groups, respectively, versus 0% with placebo.
